scientific_question: Does spatial internal morphology enrich residual-capacity information?
key_evidence: Matched scalar and surface references versus selected B-family spatial field
narrative_conclusion: Spatial morphology adds CAI-relevant information beyond lower-dimensional inputs.
control_boundary: The 0.08964 independent field estimate is sensitivity-only, not the matched confirmatory path.

scientific_question: How much registered full-field information survives sparse observation?
key_evidence: Selected 25% bilinear sparse field versus surface and full-field references
ci95_domains: gap 95% CI [0.00173, 0.01083]; favorable 5/6 versus surface and 0/6 versus full
narrative_conclusion: Sparse observations preserve most of the registered spatial gain.
control_boundary: Native-raster fraction is not physical scanner time and sparse is not equivalent to full field.

scientific_question: Is task-relevant measurement opportunity spatially heterogeneous?
key_evidence: One-shot mechanical oracle versus uniform and reconstruction oracles
effect: CAI-AUEBC improvements 0.00391 and 0.00373; 56.8% sequential headroom retained
narrative_conclusion: Specimen-specific spatial acquisition headroom exists retrospectively.
control_boundary: All oracle rows use unavailable counterfactual outcomes and are non-deployable.

scientific_question: Do downstream objectives induce distinct measurement priorities?
key_evidence: Mechanical and registered normalized-RGB-MSE reconstruction oracles plus learned global masks
effect: CAI contrast 0.04862; image-MSE contrast 5.503e-4; learned indicator 0
control_boundary: Learned global masks do not reproduce the oracle separation or establish deployment value.

scientific_question: Does measurement value evolve with inspection state?
key_evidence: Strict-OOF retrospective teacher from initial state to 18.75% checkpoint
effect: 70.4% best-action turnover; rank 0.405; top-5 overlap 0.307; opportunity 0.00531
ci95_domains: descriptive across 276 specimens and 6 held-out domains
narrative_conclusion: A fixed initial ranking omits material state-conditioned value evolution.
control_boundary: Teacher evolution does not show that the deployable scorer observes the change.

scientific_question: How does downstream predictor choice bound the task-value definition?
key_evidence: Ridge-Huber and Ridge-shallow-MLP strict-OOF value agreement
narrative_conclusion: Value is stable between comparably performing low-complexity predictors.
control_boundary: The shallow MLP is substantially less accurate; equally accurate structurally distinct predictors remain unresolved.

key_evidence: Static legal-state scorer with global and random exact-budget controls
effect: static Spearman -0.0196; set regret 0.08171 versus 0.07993 and 0.07978
narrative_conclusion: The static reference motivates conditional valuation.
control_boundary: This tested representation does not imply information-theoretic impossibility.

scientific_question: Does state-conditioned scoring capture incremental dependence?
key_evidence: Dynamic real-state scorer versus static scorer at 18.75%
narrative_conclusion: Dynamic valuation improves over the static reference.
control_boundary: The comparison alone does not identify which state-information source drives the gain.

scientific_question: Which legal-state information licenses content attribution?
key_evidence: Real content versus initial, acquired-position/history, reconstruction, and shuffled controls
ci95_domains: all matched-control CIs exclude 0; real favorable 1/6 for each source control
narrative_conclusion: Real measurements change prediction, while matched controls localize the decision signal.
control_boundary: Acquired-position/history is not geometry-only; reconstruction is registered normalized-RGB-MSE; shuffled remains the dynamic boundary.

scientific_question: Where does controlled component headroom reside?
key_evidence: Privileged valuation and bounded planning substitutions
narrative_conclusion: Valuation and planning contribute distinguishable retrospective headroom.
control_boundary: Substitutions are diagnostic and non-deployable; no representation bottleneck is claimed.

scientific_question: How much decision-level headroom remains in the reachable pool?
key_evidence: Greedy and beam-width-four selection versus retrospective joint near-oracle
narrative_conclusion: A positive two-action set-realization gap remains.
control_boundary: The near-oracle is non-deployable and does not establish arbitrary-horizon regret.

scientific_question: How does frozen end-to-end stress testing calibrate readiness?
key_evidence: Feedback/no-feedback stress test and strongest deployable outer reference
narrative_conclusion: The frozen endpoint quantifies the remaining representation-to-decision gap.
control_boundary: The no-feedback reference is retained and the learned endpoint is not performance-superior.
